            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            host TEXT NOT NULL,
            remote_port INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (remote_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),

            target_instance_id TEXT,

            )
        );
        CREATE INDEX tunnel_sessions_by_profile
